description: Consolidate all Phase 1–5 functionality into a single, self-contained Python package called 'rlqas-chem'. The package must be installable via 'pip install -e .' with no dependency on Phase 1–4 source paths. It must include all Phase 5 fixes (duplicate-action MDP fix, ent_coef=0.01, REINFORCE training) baked directly into its source code. The public API mirrors Phase 4 (rlqas_chem.search(), rlqas_chem.Experiment, CLI), but the package is fully standalone.

userStories.title: Implement Hybrid search module with Phase 5 REINFORCE fix baked in
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want rlqas_chem.search.hybrid to provide HEA-UCC hybrid circuit search with real RL policy gradient training (REINFORCE), so hybrid search genuinely learns over episodes.
fix: Apply Phase 5 fix US-004: ensure HybridSearchAgent.train(states, actions, rewards) implements REINFORCE:
- Compute discounted returns G_t with gamma=0.99
- Compute policy gradient loss L = -sum G_t * log(pi(a_t|s_t))
- If no policy network exists, add a 2-layer MLP: Linear(obs_dim,64)->ReLU->Linear(64,n_actions)->Softmax
Update rlqas_chem/search/hybrid/__init__.py to export: HybridSearchController, HybridSearchEnv, HybridFusionStrategy
acceptanceCriteria: from rlqas_chem.search.hybrid import HybridSearchController, HybridFusionStrategy
HybridSearchAgent.train() must call optimizer.step() (not a no-op)
